sections.titre: Clinique vétérinaire de cueille en quelques mots

Urgence, vaccination, toilettage ou garde : les propriétaires d'animaux cherchent vite et près de chez eux. Ces établissements, souvent de très petite taille, gagnent à disposer d'une page d'information indépendante des annuaires payants.
D'après le relevé du 18 octobre 2026, l'établissement est ouvert tous les jours sauf le dimanche. Le détail jour par jour figure plus bas.
Coordonnées géographiques : 45.25508, 1.75970. Le lien d'itinéraire ci-dessous ouvre directement la navigation.
Le contact se fait par téléphone au 05 55 20 38 50. C'est le seul moyen de communication déclaré sur la fiche Google de l'entreprise, avec la visite sur place.

liste.texte: Very friendly. Good English spoken, worming our dog before returning home from holiday.

Dr's Anne Durand and Marie-Laure Chevalier are both competent, caring and professional vets. They are both very kind with my animals and their examination and treatment of animals, is of a high standard. Mme Durand speaks excellent English as does some of her other veterinary colleagues, who are also very good. The support staff are very nice and always helpful. I would definitely recommend this vets practice.

Pros: Pleasant staff, very time efficient, brilliant service to both owner and pet, in our case 2 dogs.

Cons: The clinic can be extremely busy and sometimes it is difficult to speak with the receptionists due to many phone calls. (But the wait is worth it, You will not find the same great service anywhere else in the area)

Due to the fast diagnosis and expertise of the vets our dog was rapidly referred to an intensive care center where thankfully he made a recovery. Had the vets at Durand Chevalier not responded quickly in administering strong antibiotics in the first instance it is unlikely that our dog would be alive today.

If you are looking for a veterinary clinic whose primary interest is that of the animal this is the place!
